heading.014: Tell us the load and route
meta.001: Shared truckload freight across Ethiopia and East Africa. SharedTrucks matches compatible shipments with available vehicle space so businesses share transport costs.
meta.002: SharedTrucks Logistics — Ship your freight. Share the cost.
meta.003: Compatible freight. Shared transport costs. A connected network for shipments across Ethiopia and East Africa.
copy.005: We match small, medium and large shipments with available vehicle space across Ethiopia and East Africa. Compatible loads travelling the same corridor share the journey and the cost.
access.003: Three separate groups of freight sharing the cargo space of a single truck
copy.007: Shipments that fit the same corridor and schedule can travel together. We check cargo compatibility and coordinate pickups and deliveries without moving goods through a consolidation terminal.
copy.008: Small and medium businesses share transport costs with other shippers on the same corridor. A smaller order can move without taking on the cost of an entire vehicle.
copy.009: Transport providers fill available space on outbound and return journeys. Better matched loads help reduce empty running and make each trip more productive.
copy.010: Through Loadgistic, our team follows each vehicle’s availability, open capacity and planned route in real time as transport providers update them.
copy.011: We use that view to match compatible shipments to suitable vehicles, including space on return journeys.
access.004: Explore Loadgistic (opens in a new tab)
copy.021: The goods, route and shipment size determine the vehicle. Our network includes courier cars, cargo vans, medium trucks and large freight trucks.
